items.source_en:
Contributing Researchers: Dr. Juli Aigner, Dr. William Clarke, Kallyn Thibodeau

After conducting three weeks of intensive research on this planet's surface, our team has concluded that this location is NOT suitable for long-term human habitation. We have made this determination based on a number of factors including soil composition and the presence of a predatory fungus that infects all flora present here.

While we do not believe this planet would be well-suited for civilian life, our team suggests the development of a research outpost here. We have found significant evidence of new species on this planet that warrant study by MAST's Scientific Division. 

Our team's individual findings are documented here for posterity.

PROPERTY OF THE GALACTIC EMPIRE. DATA NOT INTENDED FOR PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION.

items.source_en:
I had our courier hyperspace jump to MAST to relay the success of the mission. There was some thought that I would deliver the news myself, but my gut feeling says that would be gauche. No one likes an "I told you so," least of all those in charge.

Besides, there is only one soul I would like to tell in person, and when my time comes, I will deliver the news with tears in my eyes.

For this is a joyous day, and yet, not what I expected. All in all, I knew I would be happy. But strangely, I don't feel relief? My original plan was to retire when this mission was over, but this battle has invigorated me. 

I'm afraid that boy with the star-bright eyes will have to wait a little longer.

게다가 제가 직접 말하고 싶은 사람은 단 한 명뿐이며, 제 시간이 오면 눈물을 머금고 그 소식을 전할 것입니다.

오늘은 기쁜 날이지만, 예상했던 것과는 다릅니다. 대체로 행복할 줄 알았는데, 이상하게도 안도감이 들지 않습니다. 원래 계획은 이 임무가 끝나면 은퇴하는 것이었지만, 이번 전투는 제게 활력을 불어넣었습니다.

별처럼 빛나는 눈을 가진 그 아이는 조금 더 기다려야 할 것 같군요.

items.source_en:
Dear Julia,

I know you were upset that I left Niamos. You know that I was extremely unhappy there, having to work off my debt in that awful resort. I hope you understand why I had to go, just as I understand why you had to stay.

Things are going very well for me here in Imperial Center. I have a job working the front desk at a small accounting business while I take classes. I'm not sure what I'm working towards yet, but I'm thinking of either majoring in Taris History, or Media Production so I can work in film. I know, big difference, but you know I've always been jealous of your job aboard the Constant, and now I can pursue something like that on my own!

I've also been seeing someone I met after striking up a conversation while getting lunch one day. Their name is Bodhi, and so far, things are going well with them.

Anyway, I hope this letter finds you soon. I've actually been thinking of coming back to visit soon!

Love,
Janet

네가 내가 니아모스를 떠난 것에 화가 났다는 걸 알아. 너도 알다시피 난 그 끔찍한 리조트에서 빚을 갚으며 일하는 게 너무나 불행했어. 내가 왜 떠나야만 했는지 이해해주길 바라. 네가 왜 그곳에 남아야 했는지 내가 이해하는 것처럼 말이야.

이곳 제국군 중심지에서의 생활은 아주 잘 풀리고 있어. 작은 회계 사무소에서 접수 업무를 보면서 수업도 듣고 있지. 아직 무엇을 목표로 하는지는 확실치 않지만, 타리스 역사를 전공하거나 영화 제작을 배워서 영상 쪽 일을 해볼까 생각 중이야. 알아, 아주 큰 차이가 있다는 거. 하지만 난 항상 콘스탄트호에서 일하는 네가 부러웠고, 이제 나 스스로 그런 일을 찾아 나설 수 있게 됐어!
